finding: The two orientation rows promise that setup leaves an existing symlink untouched. In packages/factory/scripts/init-factory:1355, setup can retarget a recognized Factory orientation link to the current destination. A scratch Codex run retargeted AGENTS.md from config/AGENTS.codex.md to config/AGENTS.md. Limit the promise to external symlinks and mention that setup can retarget a Factory orientation link.
why_this_severity: Both rows give the correct Git visibility for existing orientation symlinks (no to fails_purpose). A maintainer tracing a changed link target must consult the installer to explain it.
